chunks: Give tidings to the hypocrites that painful is their doom.

key_terms.الْمُنَافِقِينَ: The hypocrites, those who outwardly profess faith but inwardly conceal disbelief

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment promised to the hypocrites in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the specific hypocrites of Medina, such as Abdullah ibn Ubayy, whose outward piety masked inner treachery against the Ahl al-Bayt and the Prophet. It underscores the gravity of *nifaq* (hypocrisy) as a distinct spiritual disease that nullifies the benefits of outward ritual observance, warranting a unique, severe chastisement in the Hereafter.
